articles.title: JD Vance Weighs Skipping 2028 Race as Iran War Fallout Splits MAGA Coalition
articles.description: Vice President JD Vance is weighing whether to run for president in 2028 or sit out the race, according to CNN. He has made no decision. The choice comes after Republicans’ midterm losses exposed divisions in the MAGA coalition, with Vance blaming the Iran war for the defeat. Allies say the conflict could make a Republican victory in 2028 impossible if it continues. Vance is also considering whether he wants to lead the movement and how a campaign would affect his young family. While some allies say he may step aside, others still expect him to run.
